name: bow-shoot
comment: WP-2.6. ItemBow / ItemSnowball.onItemRightClick through use_item (sendPlaceBlock on the stone floor does nothing, then sendUseItem). Stone floor y 60 and a stone wall at z 8; the player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) facing +z holds a bow (slot 0) with 3 arrows in slot 5 and 4 snowballs in slot 6. t 2, 5, 8: InventoryPlayer.consumeInventoryItem takes an arrow (the slot empties at 0), the bow sound draws Item.itemRand and an EntityArrow(world, player) joins and sticks in the wall; t 11: no arrow left, nothing happens (the stack is returned unchanged either way, so used is false). t 14: hotbar 6; t 15, 17: a snowball each (stack 4 -> 2). Only the player is dumped: the arrows' and snowballs' heading jitter is drawn from their own rand in the constructor, before the join hook seeds it, so the oracle's flight is not reproducible (tools/oracle/census.md section 3); their flight draws nothing from World.rand or Math.random.
